marketLayer.title: U.S. Big Tech & AI Semiconductor Momentum
marketLayer.fact: U.S. mega-cap tech and semiconductor stocks rallied following robust enterprise earnings and sustained cloud capex commitments for AI infrastructure.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained corporate spending on AI hardware offers medium-term earnings visibility across global semiconductor and hardware supply chain partners.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Regulatory scrutiny on trade restrictions and potential supply chain bottlenecks for advanced packaging capacity.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Hang Seng Tech Index & Southbound Capital Flows
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Tech Index gained momentum supported by steady Southbound capital inflows through Stock Connect into major domestic platform operators.
marketLayer.inference: Low valuations combined with aggressive share buyback programs are improving risk-reward profiles for institutional investors re-allocating to HK equities.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of mainland domestic consumer spending recovery and ongoing price competition within e-commerce and local services.

marketLayer.title: U.S. Rate Cut Expectations & Macro Liquidity Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: U.S. economic indicators showed moderating inflation signals, reinforcing expectations of near-term Federal Reserve monetary easing.
marketLayer.inference: Easing U.S. Treasury yields relieve funding pressures on Hong Kong's banking system and improve overall valuations for rate-sensitive assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Unexpected persistence in services inflation or geopolitical shocks affecting energy markets.
